summary: Ionis Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, announcing FDA approval of TRYNGOLZA (olezarsen) for severe hypertriglyceridemia. The filing discloses clinical trial results showing triglyceride reduction and acute pancreatitis risk reduction, but includes no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction. The filing is a routine regulatory update about a product approval, not a special situation event. Therefore, no deal terms or special-situation categorization applies.
